name: MonarchCheckboxRow
title: Checkbox
summary: The Monarch checkbox: a 16dp box with a 4dp corner, a 1dp input border, the accent fill with a check mark or a dash, inside a 48dp touch target, with an optional label. MonarchCheckboxRow is the labelled row.
whenToUse: An option in a form that is submitted later, or a selection column of a list (without a label).
whenNotToUse: For a setting that takes effect immediately use a switch.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCheckbox(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchCheckbox(state: ToggleableState, onClick: (() -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
@Composable fun MonarchCheckboxRow(checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, description: String? = null)

options.name: onCheckedChange
options.description: Called with the new value; null draws the box only, for a row that handles the tap itself.

options.name: state
options.description: Off, On or Indeterminate (a dash, read as partially checked).

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; the whole row toggles and TalkBack reads it with the state.

options.name: enabled
options.description: A disabled control is drawn at half opacity and ignores input.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press and focus interactions.

states.name: checked
states.description: The control is filled with the strong accent.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled control and the disabled text color; announced as disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring around the row.

appearance: A 16dp box, 4dp corners, a 1dp input border and the surface fill. On and partly on: the strong accent fill and border with the on-accent check or dash. Invalid: the danger border. Pressed: the muted fill. Disabled: half opacity. The focus ring (2dp, 2dp away) shows for keyboard and D-pad focus.
platformNotes: Replaces the Material 3 Checkbox (18dp box, 40dp state layer). Same behaviour: toggleable with Role.Checkbox, tri-state support, a 48dp touch target around the 16dp box. Migrating: Checkbox(checked, onCheckedChange) becomes MonarchCheckbox(checked, onCheckedChange); TriStateCheckbox(state, onClick) becomes MonarchCheckbox(state, onClick); drop colors.
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack element with the checkbox role, the label, the description and the checked state.
The whole row is the touch target and is at least 48dp high.
A disabled row is announced as disabled.
The box is at the start and follows the layout direction.
The bare Checkbox needs a name: Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = ... }.
edgeCases: A long label wraps beside the box and the row grows.
Inside the row the Checkbox has no click handler of its own, so there is one target, not two.

examples.title: Inline label and indeterminate
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    MonarchCheckbox(
        checked = updates,
        onCheckedChange = { updates = it },
        label = {{items.0.label}},
        description = {{items.0.description}},
    )
    MonarchCheckbox(
        state = if ({{items.1.indeterminate}}) ToggleableState.Indeterminate else ToggleableState.Off,
        onClick = {},
        label = {{items.1.label}},
    )
    MonarchCheckbox(
        checked = false,
        onCheckedChange = {},
        enabled = !{{items.2.disabled}},
        label = {{items.2.label}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    MonarchCheckbox(
        checked = updates,
        onCheckedChange = { updates = it },
        label = "Email me updates",
        description = "About once a month.",
    )
    MonarchCheckbox(
        state = if (true) ToggleableState.Indeterminate else ToggleableState.Off,
        onClick = {},
        label = "Select all",
    )
    MonarchCheckbox(
        checked = false,
        onCheckedChange = {},
        enabled = !true,
        label = "Unavailable",
    )
}
